description: A beginner-friendly horizontal bodyweight pull utilizing a sturdy table edge or low bar to build back strength.
setup: Lie face up under a sturdy table, gripping the edge with hands shoulder-width apart, heels planted on the floor, and body straight.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze glutes so your body forms a straight ramp from heels to shoulders.
Pull your chest up toward the table edge by driving elbows back.
Touch your chest lightly to the underside of the table edge.
Lower yourself smoothly back to straight arms under control.
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top of the pull
Keep hips elevated and body rigid like a reverse plank

mistakes.mistake: Sagging hips and pulling only with the arms
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and abs to keep torso and legs in a rigid straight line

mistakes.mistake: Reaching with the chin instead of touching chest to table
mistakes.fix: Keep neck neutral and pull until chest contacts the table edge

rep_standard: Begins with arms fully straight and body elevated off floor, pulls until chest contacts table edge, and returns to full arm extension.
